name: Fretwork
description: Pierced fretwork: a key pattern cut clean out of the panel, so the light does the drawing.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M0 0 H100 V100 H0 Z M18 18 H64 V30 H18 Z M52 18 H64 V64 H52 Z M30 52 H64 V64 H30 Z; fill-rule: evenodd; fill: #000 }); mask: @svg(viewBox: 0 0 100 100; path { d: M0 0 H100 V100 H0 Z M18 18 H64 V30 H18 Z M52 18 H64 V64 H52 Z M30 52 H64 V64 H30 Z; fill-rule: evenodd; fill: #000 }); -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
